panel: Same ordered 16 CG-001 baseline cases; no case selection, additions or removed denominators
route: Neural argmax on initial user-prefill only, fixed for the reply; no reference labels in forward
execution: Two independent case workers, separate tokenizers and C processes/contexts. Each C process uses the qualified four-thread ARM numerical domain; results serialized in original panel order.
verification: Every prefix recomputed by ordinary C reference, C zero-residual base and selected-residual C projection. Base hidden/logits must match exactly; normal route must preserve base logits exactly.
review: Mixed identity-blinded baseline and candidate outputs, two independent reviewer contexts, unchanged rubric and paired controls; retain truncation and disagreements
scope: Python neural control/fusion with real C backbone/projection, supplied single event; not full C memory, automatic writer, HTTP or LoCoMo
